037/**
038 * A factory for creating objects from package names and names.
039 * Consider the below example for better understanding.
040 * <ul>
041 *     <li>module name - name of java class that represents module;</li>
042 *     <li>module full name - fully qualifies name of java class that represents module;</li>
043 *     <li>check module short name - name of Check without 'Check' suffix;</li>
044 *     <li>check module name - name of java class that represents Check (with 'Check' suffix);</li>
045 *     <li>
046 *         check module full name - fully qualifies name of java class
047 *         that represents Check (with 'Check' suffix).
048 *     </li>
049 * </ul>
050 */
051public class PackageObjectFactory implements ModuleFactory {
052
053    /**
054     * Enum class to define loading options.
055     */
056    public enum ModuleLoadOption {
057
058        /**
059         * Searching from registered checkstyle modules and from packages given in constructor.
060         **/
061        SEARCH_REGISTERED_PACKAGES,
062        /**
063         * As SEARCH_REGISTERED_PACKAGES and also try to load class from all of packages given in
064         * constructor.
065         * Required for eclipse-cs plugin.
066         **/
067        TRY_IN_ALL_REGISTERED_PACKAGES,
068
069    }
070
071    /** Base package of checkstyle modules checks. */
072    public static final String BASE_PACKAGE = "com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle";
073
074    /** Exception message when it is unable to create a class instance. */
075    public static final String UNABLE_TO_INSTANTIATE_EXCEPTION_MESSAGE =
076            "PackageObjectFactory.unableToInstantiateExceptionMessage";
077
078    /** Exception message when there is ambiguous module name in config file. */
079    public static final String AMBIGUOUS_MODULE_NAME_EXCEPTION_MESSAGE =
080            "PackageObjectFactory.ambiguousModuleNameExceptionMessage";
081
082    /** Suffix of checks. */
083    public static final String CHECK_SUFFIX = "Check";
084
085    /** Character separate package names in qualified name of java class. */
086    public static final String PACKAGE_SEPARATOR = ".";
087
088    /** Exception message when null class loader is given. */
089    public static final String NULL_LOADER_MESSAGE = "moduleClassLoader must not be null";
090
091    /** Exception message when null package name is given. */
092    public static final String NULL_PACKAGE_MESSAGE = "package name must not be null";
093
094    /** Separator to use in strings. */
095    public static final String STRING_SEPARATOR = ", ";
096
097    /** Map of Checkstyle module names to their fully qualified names. */
098    private static final Map<String, String> NAME_TO_FULL_MODULE_NAME = new HashMap<>();
099
100    /** Package names to prepend to class names. */
101    private final Set<String> packages;
102
103    /** The class loader used to load Checkstyle core and custom modules. */
104    private final ClassLoader moduleClassLoader;
105
106    /** Map of third party Checkstyle module names to the set of their fully qualified names. */
107    private Map<String, Set<String>> thirdPartyNameToFullModuleNames;
108
109    /** Module load option which defines class search type. */
110    private ModuleLoadOption moduleLoadOption;
111
112    static {
113        fillShortToFullModuleNamesMap();
114    }
115
116    /**
117     * Creates a new {@code PackageObjectFactory} instance.
118     *
119     * @param packageNames package names to use
120     * @param moduleClassLoader class loader used to load Checkstyle
121     *          core and custom modules
122     */
123    public PackageObjectFactory(Set<String> packageNames, ClassLoader moduleClassLoader) {
124        this(packageNames, moduleClassLoader, ModuleLoadOption.SEARCH_REGISTERED_PACKAGES);
125    }
126
127    /**
128     * Creates a new {@code PackageObjectFactory} instance.
129     *
130     * @param packageName The package name to use
131     * @param moduleClassLoader class loader used to load Checkstyle
132     *          core and custom modules
133     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if moduleClassLoader is null or packageNames is null
134     */
135    public PackageObjectFactory(String packageName, ClassLoader moduleClassLoader) {
136        if (moduleClassLoader == null) {
137            throw new IllegalArgumentException(NULL_LOADER_MESSAGE);
138        }
139        if (packageName == null) {
140            throw new IllegalArgumentException(NULL_PACKAGE_MESSAGE);
141        }
142
143        packages = Set.of(packageName);
144        this.moduleClassLoader = moduleClassLoader;
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * Creates a new {@code PackageObjectFactory} instance.
149     *
150     * @param packageNames package names to use
151     * @param moduleClassLoader class loader used to load Checkstyle
152     *          core and custom modules
153     * @param moduleLoadOption loading option
154     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if moduleClassLoader is null or packageNames contains null
155     */
156    public PackageObjectFactory(Set<String> packageNames, ClassLoader moduleClassLoader,
157            ModuleLoadOption moduleLoadOption) {
158        if (moduleClassLoader == null) {
159            throw new IllegalArgumentException(NULL_LOADER_MESSAGE);
160        }
161        if (packageNames.contains(null)) {
162            throw new IllegalArgumentException(NULL_PACKAGE_MESSAGE);
163        }
164
165        // create a copy of the given set, but retain ordering
166        packages = new LinkedHashSet<>(packageNames);
167        this.moduleClassLoader = moduleClassLoader;
168        this.moduleLoadOption = moduleLoadOption;
169    }
170
171    /**
172     * Creates a new instance of a class from a given name, or that name
173     * concatenated with &quot;Check&quot;. If the name is
174     * a class name, creates an instance of the named class. Otherwise, creates
175     * an instance of a class name obtained by concatenating the given name
176     * to a package name from a given list of package names.
177     *
178     * @param name the name of a class.
179     * @return the {@code Object} created by loader.
180     * @throws CheckstyleException if an error occurs.
181     */
182    @Override
183    public Object createModule(String name) throws CheckstyleException {
184        Object instance = null;
185        // if the name is a simple class name, try to find it in maps at first
186        if (!name.contains(PACKAGE_SEPARATOR)) {
187            instance = createFromStandardCheckSet(name);
188            // find the name in third party map
189            if (instance == null) {
190                instance = createObjectFromClassPath(name);
191            }
192        }
193        if (instance == null) {
194            instance = createObject(name);
195        }
196        if (instance == null
197                && moduleLoadOption == ModuleLoadOption.TRY_IN_ALL_REGISTERED_PACKAGES) {
198            instance = createModuleByTryInEachPackage(name);
199        }
200        if (instance == null) {
201            String attemptedNames = null;
202            if (!name.contains(PACKAGE_SEPARATOR)) {
203                final String nameCheck = name + CHECK_SUFFIX;
204                attemptedNames = joinPackageNamesWithClassName(name, packages)
205                        + STRING_SEPARATOR + nameCheck + STRING_SEPARATOR
206                        + joinPackageNamesWithClassName(nameCheck, packages);
207            }
208            final LocalizedMessage exceptionMessage = new LocalizedMessage(
209                Definitions.CHECKSTYLE_BUNDLE, getClass(),
210                UNABLE_TO_INSTANTIATE_EXCEPTION_MESSAGE, name, attemptedNames);
211            throw new CheckstyleException(exceptionMessage.getMessage());
212        }
213        return instance;
214    }
215
216    /**
217     * Create object from one of Checkstyle module names.
218     *
219     * @param name name of module.
220     * @return instance of module.
221     * @throws CheckstyleException if the class fails to instantiate or there are ambiguous classes.
222     */
223    private Object createFromStandardCheckSet(String name) throws CheckstyleException {
224        final String fullModuleName = NAME_TO_FULL_MODULE_NAME.get(name);
225        Object instance = null;
226        if (fullModuleName == null) {
227            final String fullCheckModuleName =
228                    NAME_TO_FULL_MODULE_NAME.get(name + CHECK_SUFFIX);
229            if (fullCheckModuleName != null) {
230                instance = createObject(fullCheckModuleName);
231            }
232        }
233        else {
234            instance = createObject(fullModuleName);
235        }
236        return instance;
237    }
238
239    /**
240     * Create object with the help of the classpath.
241     *
242     * @param name name of module.
243     * @return instance of module if it is found in modules map and no ambiguous classes exist.
244     * @throws CheckstyleException if the class fails to instantiate or there are ambiguous classes.
245     */
246    private Object createObjectFromClassPath(String name)
247            throws CheckstyleException {
248        thirdPartyNameToFullModuleNames = lazyLoad(
249                thirdPartyNameToFullModuleNames,
250                () -> generateThirdPartyNameToFullModuleName(moduleClassLoader)
251        );
252        final Set<String> fullModuleNames = thirdPartyNameToFullModuleNames.get(name);
253        Object instance = null;
254        if (fullModuleNames == null) {
255            final Set<String> fullCheckModuleNames =
256                    thirdPartyNameToFullModuleNames.get(name + CHECK_SUFFIX);
257            if (fullCheckModuleNames != null) {
258                instance = createObjectFromFullModuleNames(name, fullCheckModuleNames);
259            }
260        }
261        else {
262            instance = createObjectFromFullModuleNames(name, fullModuleNames);
263        }
264        return instance;
265    }
266
267    /**
268     * Create Object from optional full module names.
269     * In most case, there should be only one element in {@code fullModuleNames}, otherwise
270     * an exception would be thrown.
271     *
272     * @param name name of module
273     * @param fullModuleNames the supplied full module names set
274     * @return instance of module if there is only one element in {@code fullModuleNames}
275     * @throws CheckstyleException if the class fails to instantiate or there are more than one
276     *      element in {@code fullModuleNames}
277     */
278    private Object createObjectFromFullModuleNames(String name, Set<String> fullModuleNames)
279            throws CheckstyleException {
280        final Object returnValue;
281        if (fullModuleNames.size() == 1) {
282            returnValue = createObject(fullModuleNames.iterator().next());
283        }
284        else {
285            final String optionalNames = fullModuleNames.stream()
286                    .sorted()
287                    .collect(Collectors.joining(STRING_SEPARATOR));
288            final LocalizedMessage exceptionMessage = new LocalizedMessage(
289                    Definitions.CHECKSTYLE_BUNDLE, getClass(),
290                    AMBIGUOUS_MODULE_NAME_EXCEPTION_MESSAGE, name, optionalNames);
291            throw new CheckstyleException(exceptionMessage.getMessage());
292        }
293        return returnValue;
294    }
295
296    /**
297     * Generate the map of third party Checkstyle module names to the set of their fully qualified
298     * names.
299     *
300     * @param loader the class loader used to load Checkstyle package names
301     * @return the map of third party Checkstyle module names to the set of their fully qualified
302     *      names
303     */
304    private Map<String, Set<String>> generateThirdPartyNameToFullModuleName(ClassLoader loader) {
305        Map<String, Set<String>> returnValue;
306        try {
307            returnValue = ModuleReflectionUtil.getCheckstyleModules(packages, loader).stream()
308                .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(Class::getSimpleName,
309                    Collectors.mapping(
310                        Class::getCanonicalName,
311                        Collectors.toCollection(HashSet::new))));
312        }
313        catch (IOException ignore) {
314            returnValue = Map.of();
315        }
316        return returnValue;
317    }
318
319    /**
320     * Returns simple check name from full modules names map.
321     *
322     * @param fullName name of the class for joining.
323     * @return simple check name.
324     */
325    public static String getShortFromFullModuleNames(String fullName) {
326        return NAME_TO_FULL_MODULE_NAME
327                .entrySet()
328                .stream()
329                .filter(entry -> entry.getValue().equals(fullName))
330                .findFirst()
331                .map(Entry::getKey)
332                .orElse(fullName);
333    }
334
335    /**
336     * Creates a string by joining package names with a class name.
337     *
338     * @param className name of the class for joining.
339     * @param packages packages names.
340     * @return a string which is obtained by joining package names with a class name.
341     */
342    private static String joinPackageNamesWithClassName(String className, Set<String> packages) {
343        return packages.stream().collect(
344            Collectors.joining(PACKAGE_SEPARATOR + className + STRING_SEPARATOR, "",
345                    PACKAGE_SEPARATOR + className));
346    }
347
348    /**
349     * Creates a new instance of a named class.
350     *
351     * @param className the name of the class to instantiate.
352     * @return the {@code Object} created by loader or null.
353     * @throws CheckstyleException if the class fails to instantiate.
354     */
355    private Object createObject(String className) throws CheckstyleException {
356        Class<?> clazz = null;
357
358        try {
359            clazz = Class.forName(className, true, moduleClassLoader);
360        }
361        catch (final ReflectiveOperationException | NoClassDefFoundError ignored) {
362            // ignore the exception
363        }
364
365        Object instance = null;
366
367        if (clazz != null) {
368            try {
369                instance = clazz.getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
370            }
371            catch (final ReflectiveOperationException exc) {
372                throw new CheckstyleException("Unable to instantiate " + className, exc);
373            }
374        }
375
376        return instance;
377    }
378
379    /**
380     * Searching to class with given name (or name concatenated with &quot;Check&quot;) in existing
381     * packages. Returns instance if class found or, otherwise, null.
382     *
383     * @param name the name of a class.
384     * @return the {@code Object} created by loader.
385     * @throws CheckstyleException if an error occurs.
386     */
387    private Object createModuleByTryInEachPackage(String name) throws CheckstyleException {
388        final List<String> possibleNames = packages.stream()
389            .map(packageName -> packageName + PACKAGE_SEPARATOR + name)
390            .flatMap(className -> Stream.of(className, className + CHECK_SUFFIX))
391            .toList();
392        Object instance = null;
393        for (String possibleName : possibleNames) {
394            instance = createObject(possibleName);
395            if (instance != null) {
396                break;
397            }
398        }
399        return instance;
400    }
401
402    /**
403     * Initialize object by supplier if object is null.
404     *
405     * @param <T> type of object
406     * @param object object to initialize
407     * @param supplier function to initialize if object is null
408     * @return object as it was provided in method or initialized
409     */
410    private static <T> T lazyLoad(T object, Supplier<T> supplier) {
411        final T result;
412        if (object == null) {
413            result = supplier.get();
414        }
415        else {
416            result = object;
417        }
418        return result;
419    }

438        fillChecksFromWhitespacePackage();
439        fillModulesFromChecksPackage();
440        fillModulesFromFilefiltersPackage();
441        fillModulesFromFiltersPackage();
442        fillModulesFromCheckstylePackage();
443    }
